candidate_findings.title: Proxy credentials leakage on TLS tunneled HTTPS requests
candidate_findings.description: Proxy-Authorization header must not be attached to HTTPS requests where TLS tunnel prevents proxy from stripping it.

+++ b/Lib/urllib/parse.py
@@ -3,3 +3,5 @@ def urlsplit(url, scheme='', allow_fragments=True):

     if '#' in url:

file_contents.Lib/urllib/parse.py:
_c0_control_and_space = tuple(chr(i) for i in range(0x20 + 1))

def urlsplit(url, scheme='', allow_fragments=True):
    # Strip leading C0 control and space characters
    url = url.lstrip(_c0_control_and_space)
    if '#' in url:
        url, fragment = url.split('#', 1)
    return url

candidate_findings.title: Leading whitespace characters bypass URL scheme blocklist
candidate_findings.description: URLs with leading whitespace or C0 controls cause urlsplit to fail extracting the real scheme, bypassing security filters.
candidate_findings.suggested_remediation: Strip leading C0 controls and whitespace before parsing.

description: ZeroDivisionError when computing rate smoothing when delta_t is zero
diff_text:
diff --git a/tqdm/std.py b/tqdm/std.py
--- a/tqdm/std.py
+++ b/tqdm/std.py
@@ -2,3 +2,5 @@ class tqdm:
-        rate = dn / delta_t
+        if delta_t <= 0:
+            return 0.0
+        rate = dn / delta_t

candidate_findings.title: ZeroDivisionError in progress rate calculation
candidate_findings.description: When timer delta_t is 0, dividing dn by delta_t causes an unhandled ZeroDivisionError.
candidate_findings.suggested_remediation: Guard division by checking if delta_t <= 0.
